# Hooks and logger

## Hooks

Hooks observe every HTTP **attempt** (retries included) for metrics, auditing or debugging. All
data they receive is **already redacted**: sensitive headers show `[REDACTED]` and the URL has its
sensitive query values redacted. An exception thrown by a hook is caught and ignored, so hooks can
never break a call.

| Hook | Data |
| - | - |
| `onRequest` | `RequestInfo { method, url, headers, attempt }` (attempt starts at 1) |
| `onResponse` | `ResponseInfo { method, url, status, durationMs, attempt, requestId? }` |
| `onError` | `ErrorInfo { method, url, error, attempt, willRetry }` |

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    const client = new VaultClient({
      hooks: {
        onRequest: (r) => console.debug("->", r.method, r.url, "attempt", r.attempt),
        onResponse: (r) => metrics.observe(r.status, r.durationMs),
        onError: (e) => console.warn(e.error.code, "willRetry", e.willRetry),
      },
    });
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use grow_hashicorp_vault::core::{ErrorInfo, Hooks, RequestInfo, ResponseInfo};

    struct Metrics;

    impl Hooks for Metrics {
        fn on_request(&self, r: &RequestInfo) {
            println!("-> {} {} attempt {}", r.method, r.url, r.attempt);
        }
        fn on_response(&self, r: &ResponseInfo) {
            println!("<- {} in {:?}", r.status, r.duration);
        }
        fn on_error(&self, e: &ErrorInfo) {
            eprintln!("{:?} will_retry={}", e.error.code(), e.will_retry);
        }
    }

    let config = VaultConfig::builder().hooks(Arc::new(Metrics)).build()?;
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    cfg := vault.Config{CommonConfig: vault.CommonConfig{
        Hooks: &vault.Hooks{
            OnRequest:  func(r vault.RequestInfo) { log.Printf("-> %s %s attempt %d", r.Method, r.URL, r.Attempt) },
            OnResponse: func(r vault.ResponseInfo) { log.Printf("<- %d in %s", r.Status, r.Duration) },
            OnError:    func(e vault.ErrorInfo) { log.Printf("%v willRetry=%t", e.Err, e.WillRetry) },
        },
    }}
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from grow_hashicorp_vault import Hooks, VaultConfig

    config = VaultConfig(
        hooks=Hooks(
            on_request=lambda r: print("->", r.method, r.url, "attempt", r.attempt),
            on_response=lambda r: print("<-", r.status, r.duration_ms),
            on_error=lambda e: print(type(e.error).__name__, "will_retry", e.will_retry),
        )
    )
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    Hooks hooks = new Hooks() {
      @Override public void onRequest(Hooks.RequestInfo r) {
        System.out.println("-> " + r.method() + " " + r.url() + " attempt " + r.attempt());
      }
      @Override public void onResponse(Hooks.ResponseInfo r) {
        System.out.println("<- " + r.status() + " in " + r.durationMs() + " ms");
      }
      @Override public void onError(Hooks.ErrorInfo e) {
        System.out.println(e.error().code() + " willRetry=" + e.willRetry());
      }
    };
    VaultConfig config = VaultConfig.builder().hooks(hooks).build();
    ```

## Logger

The client writes diagnostic messages (retries, TLS warnings, closed resources) to a logger. It is
**silent by default** and never logs secrets.

| Language | Default | How to enable |
| - | - | - |
| TypeScript | silent | `logger: { debug, info, warn, error }` in the config (for example `console`) |
| Rust | `tracing` events at `debug` | install a `tracing` subscriber in your application |
| Go | `*slog.Logger` that discards | `CommonConfig.Logger: slog.Default()` |
| Python | `logging.getLogger("grow_hashicorp_vault")` with a `NullHandler` | configure the `grow_hashicorp_vault` logger, or pass `logger=` |
| Java | no-op (no SLF4J dependency) | `.logger(...)` with an implementation of `codes.grow.packages.vault.core.Logger` |

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    const client = new VaultClient({ logger: console });
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_env_filter("grow_hashicorp_vault=debug").init();
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    cfg := vault.Config{CommonConfig: vault.CommonConfig{Logger: slog.Default()}}
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    import logging
    logging.basicConfig()
    logging.getLogger("grow_hashicorp_vault").setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    Logger stderr = new Logger() {
      @Override public void warn(String message, Map<String, Object> fields) {
        System.err.println(message + " " + fields);
      }
    };
    VaultConfig config = VaultConfig.builder().logger(stderr).build();
    ```
